subject: general
question: Who among the following invented and perfected India’s classical dance form Sattras?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Srimanta Sankardev.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Srimanta Sankardev invented and perfected India’s classical dance form Sattras.**
 
• It is believed that Bharatnatyam was revealed by Lord Brahma to Bharata, a famous sage who then codified this sacred dance in a Sanskrit text called the** Natya Shastra.**
 
• Sattriya is a classical Indian dance that originated in its eastern state of Assam.
 
• There are nine classical dance forms in India, which include **Bharatnatyam, Kathak, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Manipuri, Mohiniyattam, sattriya, and chhau.**
 
• Bharatanatyam is the first classical dance practice in India. The dance form was predominant in primeval Tamil Nadu, and numerous records have veiled them such as Natya Shastra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **K. Uma Rama Rao** born Uma Maheshwari on **4 July 1938 – 27 August 2016** was an Indian Kuchipudi dancer, choreographer, research scholar, author, and dance teacher.
 
• She was also the Founder & Director of Lasya Priya Dance Academy, established in **1985 **in Hyderabad, India.
 
• **Uday Shankar **was an artist, dancer, and choreographer who popularized Indian dance through his effective use of western theatrical techniques in combination with classical Indian dance.
 
• Uday Shankar **(8 December 1900 – 26 September 1977) **was an Indian dancer and choreographer.
 
• Uday Shankar was the first to bring the concept of modern dance to India with his novel approach and works
 
• **Guru Gopinath **was an exponent of various styles of Indian dances. The illustrious 'Raam Leela' of Delhi, choreographed and directed by him was its glorious proof.
